newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian power firm seeks to recover debts urgentl.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian power firm seeks to recover debts urgentl.

text.p: Nigeria's state-run Nigerian National Electric Power Authority (NEPA), which is believed to be slated for privatisation, is urgently seeking to recover 12 billion naira ($156.9 million) owed by federal and local governments, its chief executive said on Friday.

The News Agency of Nigeria quoted Hamza Abdullahi as telling NEPA managers at a meeting in the capital Abuja that recovering the debts within the next two months was crucial to maintaining the utility's facilities.

Nigeria's military ruler General Sani Abacha is widely expected to announce in the 1997 fiscal budget this weekend, that some state enterprises including NEPA would be sold off to the private sector to improve their efficiency.
